decision.explanation: The question asks for the birth year of the '2nd Duke of Newcastle,' which is ambiguous because there are at least two historical figures who held that title. Document D1S1 refers to Henry Cavendish, 2nd Duke of Newcastle-upon-Tyne, born on 24 June 1630. Document D2S1 refers to Henry Pelham-Clinton, 2nd Duke of Newcastle-under-Lyne, born on 16 April 1720. Both are valid referents for the title '2nd Duke of Newcastle' depending on the lineage and dukedom in question. The audit reflects uncertainty in entity disambiguation ('E0' and 'E1'), but both answers are directly supported by their respective sources and should be retained as distinct valid answers.
